worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.summary: Hits nearby enemies that share the user’s frequency and briefly outlines them. Pokémon match by type; ordinary bodies match by kind.
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.use.0: Sweep a whole ring of same-type foes at once
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.use.1: Pick out only the ones tuned to you in a melee
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.use.2: Leave a resonance mark to follow up on
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.use.3: Find out who is actually on your type in a mismatched fight
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.descripti: Each matching enemy takes about %1$s damage, with target defenses, type matchups, and critical hits resolved on impact.
The wave sweeps %1$s blocks around the caster all at once.
Resonance lasts %1$s seconds and outlines the target for tracking. The outline stops shortly after resonance ends or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.tight.on: Tight tuning on: the wave is about ×0.62 wide and about ×1.42 stronger with a longer resonance, but wind-up +2 and cooldown +6 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.tight.off: Tight tuning off (wide broadcast): the wave is ×1.0 wide and ×1.0 power with a shorter wind-up and cooldown, for sweeping as many same-type foes as possible in a melee.
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.growth.0: At level %1$s the resonance rises to %2$s and the wave to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.preferenc: On: the wave is about ×0.62 wide and about ×1.42 stronger with a longer resonance, wind-up +2 and cooldown +6 ticks, for punching through one same-type target. Off (wide broadcast): about ×1.0 wide and ×1.0 power, for sweeping as many same-type foes as possible in a melee.
The companion only considers Synchronoise when a same-type target is this close; lower it to broadcast only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
At least this many visible, hostile, same-type targets must stand within range before it broadcasts; raise it for clustered same-type use, set it to 1 to fire at a single match.
worldcombat.skill.synchronoise.descripti: Ordinary frequencies: undead—Ghost; arthropods—Bug; aquatic bodies—Water; blazes and magma cubes—Fire; iron golems—Steel; snow golems—Ice; the ender dragon—Dragon. Others normally match Normal.
